blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-30. Sole catalogued deployment is Hemi 0x7188…0aa1. Verified source (explorer API) is OpenZeppelin ERC20 + ERC20Burnable + Ownable and states free transferability; onlyOwner mint(address,uint256) is the sole privileged path; burn paths are the stock holder/allowance burns (burn(uint256) present; no burn(address,uint256) onlyOwner seize). At Hemi block 4965111: non-proxy (EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots zero); owner()=Safe 0x3ede…75Be; bytecode lacks pause/paused/isBlacklisted/blacklist/freeze/setOperator selectors. No upstream stablecoin wrapper inheritance. Freeze reach is none; transfer posture is permissionless. Transfer categorical publication still requires chainCirculatingById for material deployment scope.

oracleRisk.summary: The exact Hemi VCRED source declares a USD peg but has no price-sensitive mint, burn or redemption input. The linked website's staking/access-token and AI/perp-vault descriptions have not been joined to this exact deployment.

branchApplicability.rationale: At Hemi block 5426142, the tracked deployment's runtime bytecode exactly matched the explorer's verified non-proxy ERC-20 source. It has owner minting and standard holder/allowance burns, with no oracle, NAV, exchange-rate, redemption payout or rebalance input. The separately advertised AI/perp vaults consume market data but have no established identity or holder-claim join to this Hemi token. This not-applicable oracle verdict is scoped to the inspected exact token implementation and grants no reserve, stablecoin-eligibility or vault-receipt claim.
